profiles.description: Washington Prime Group (WPG) operates as a prominent retail Real Estate Investment Trust, specializing in the full spectrum of retail property activities, from acquisition and development to ownership and management. The firm leverages its expansive national property portfolio alongside its deep industry acumen within the shopping center domain. This strategic combination allows WPG to generate increased cash flow through meticulous asset oversight and to create valuable expansion opportunities for retailers throughout the United States. The designation "Washington Prime Group®" is a proprietary trademark held by the company.
